brandsJoin.heading: How your brand appears on Formoria
brandsJoin.heroDescription: Formoria gathers and sorts what is known about Taiwanese brands so readers can look by what they need. The brand directory lists brands under published rules; Formoria Selection is chosen independently by editors; every purchase link goes back to the brand's own channel.
brandsJoin.valueProp1Description: Once approved, your brand is listed under its category, where visitors can find it by browsing or searching.
brandsJoin.valueProp2Description: Editors decide selections on their own. Whether a brand has contacted us or supplied details never affects what gets picked.
brandsJoin.valueProp3Description: Every purchase link goes to your own site or store. Formoria never handles a transaction.
brandsJoin.trustLabelDirectory: Listed brand — a brand that meets our listing rules and passed review. Not a recommendation, certification, or ranking.
brandsJoin.trustLabelSelection: Formoria Selection — a product editors chose for a specific situation, each with a written reason. Brands can't apply for it or pay for it.
brandsJoin.trustLabelProvided: Brand-provided — facts or images a brand supplied, with the source shown. Supplying them guarantees neither publication nor any say in what we write.
brandsJoin.trustLabelSponsored: Sponsored — paid or commercial content, clearly labeled and kept apart from everything else.
brandsJoin.trustLabelSiteConfirmed: Confirmed by Formoria — a fact Formoria checked itself, most often a stockist a community member suggested and an editor reviewed.
brandsJoin.howItWorksStep1: Send the brand name through the recommendation form, with a link to your website or online store.
brandsJoin.howItWorksStep2: The Formoria team reviews the details to confirm the brand meets our listing rules.
brandsJoin.howItWorksStep3: Once approved, your brand is listed in the brand directory, where visitors can find it.
brandsJoin.ctaDescription: Submit through the recommendation form for now. After approval, we'll be in touch about managing the listing.

descriptions.fashion: The wardrobe is missing one jacket you can wear to work and then straight out to dinner. Fashion and apparel covers everyday basics, commuting and outerwear, technical outdoor layers, footwear, and the accessories worn with them; materials, sizing, and place of manufacture follow each brand's own statements. Formoria lists apparel and footwear brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan.
descriptions.bags-accessories: A bag has to hold a laptop, a water bottle, and a lunch box — without the strap digging in. Bags and accessories covers commuter bags, backpacks, travel bags, wallets, and small leather goods, and some brands work with recycled fabrics or vegetable-tanned leather. Formoria lists bag and accessory brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan, and gathers each brand's online stores and stockists.
descriptions.jewelry: A pair of earrings you can wear every day and keep on in the shower. Jewelry covers earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, and hair accessories, in materials from sterling silver, brass, and stainless steel to natural stones and freshwater pearls; metal composition and care instructions are stated by each brand. Formoria lists jewelry brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan.
descriptions.beauty: Taiwanese summers are hot and humid, so texture is often decided before the ingredient list is. Beauty and personal care covers facial skincare, haircare, body cleansing, and makeup, and many brands use local plants, mineral springs, or fermented ingredients. Formoria lists beauty brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan; for ingredients and suitability, follow each brand's own labelling.
descriptions.home: Moving into a new home, changing a lamp, wanting the dining table to look different. Home and living covers furniture, storage, lighting, tableware, and decor, often in ceramics, wood, woven bamboo, and metalwork; in a small apartment the dimensions usually settle the choice before the style does. Formoria lists home and living brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan.
descriptions.food-drink: A gift to send home, or a bag of coffee beans that runs out every morning. Food and beverage covers tea, coffee, fruit and farm produce, snacks, sauces, and traditional confections, and some brands work directly with growers. Formoria lists food and drink brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan; for storage, ingredients, and delivery terms, see each brand's own pages.
descriptions.stationery: A notebook that lies flat and doesn't bleed through under a fountain pen. Stationery and design covers notebooks, paper goods, pens, washi tape, stamps, and desk tools, and many brands work with local paper mills, printers, or illustrators. Formoria lists stationery and design brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan.
descriptions.tech: One more cable on the desk and it is a mess, so charging, expansion, and cable management usually get solved together. Tech and electronics covers consumer electronics, computer peripherals, creator tools, and smart home devices. Formoria lists tech brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan; for specifications, compatibility, and warranty terms, follow each brand's official documentation.
descriptions.outdoor: A weekend in the mountains means carrying the sleeping bag, the stove, and the pack yourself. Outdoor and camping covers hiking, camping, climbing, and travel gear, along with the apparel, packs, and accessories that go with them; between high ridgelines and coastal campsites, low weight and damp resistance are the usual trade-off. Formoria lists outdoor and camping brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan.
descriptions.fitness: A mat unrolled in the living room after work is the whole training space for the day. Fitness and sports covers yoga mats, resistance training equipment, activewear, and recovery tools; size, weight, and how a piece stores away often decide whether it gets used at all. Formoria lists fitness and sports brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan.
descriptions.kids: Children put things in their mouths, and grow half a size in a season. Kids & Baby covers children's and baby clothing, bedding, wooden and fabric toys, feeding goods, and parenting essentials, where the material and how it washes are usually the first things to check. Formoria lists kids and baby brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan; for safety labelling and test reports, follow each brand's own announcements.
descriptions.pets: Cats chew toys open, and leads get dragged across wet asphalt. Pets covers fresh food and treats, supplements, apparel and accessories, scratchers and beds, and grooming supplies, where durability and how a thing washes are usually the first things to check. Formoria lists pet brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan; for ingredients and test reports, follow each brand's own announcements.

home.title: Taiwanese home and living brands | Formoria
home.description: In a small apartment, size and storage usually settle the choice before style does. Taiwanese brands for furniture, storage, lighting, and tableware.
home.intro: From furniture and storage to lighting, tableware, and small decor pieces; in a small apartment, dimensions and how something stores away usually settle the choice before style does.
home.definition: This category covers things that make a home easier to live in, not only decorative pieces. Brands are grouped by the product types recorded when they were approved.

faq.question: What products appear in Home & Living?
faq.answer: Common examples include furniture, storage, lighting, tableware, fragrance, and small decor objects. The exact tags follow each brand's main products.

faq.question: Are all brands in this category made in Taiwan?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Formoria lists brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan; manufacturing details are shown separately when a brand provides them.

fashion.title: Taiwanese fashion and apparel brands | Formoria
fashion.description: One jacket has to work at the office and then straight out to dinner. Clothing, footwear, and accessory brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan.
fashion.intro: Clothing, footwear, and the accessories worn with them; one jacket has to work at the office and then straight out to dinner.
fashion.definition: A fashion brand's point of view may come from cut, textile, last, or the setting in which a piece is worn. This category does not claim that every item is made in Taiwan; brand pages list where a brand was founded, designs, and manufactures separately.

faq.question: What brands are included in Fashion & Apparel?
faq.answer: Everyday clothing, technical layers, casual shoes, leather shoes, and other wearables may appear when they match a brand's main products and public tags.

faq.question: Where can I find a brand's origin details?
faq.answer: Each brand page separates founding, design, and manufacturing information. The category page does not treat every listed label as Taiwan-made.

beauty.title: Taiwanese beauty and personal care brands | Formoria
beauty.description: Taiwan's humid heat means texture and feel get judged first. Taiwanese brands for skincare, makeup, haircare, and body cleansing.
beauty.h1: Taiwanese beauty and personal care brands
beauty.intro: Skincare, makeup, haircare, and body cleansing; in Taiwan's humid heat, texture and how something feels on the skin get judged first.
beauty.definition: The category is organised by body area and function, not by a promise that a product is natural, additive-free, or suitable for every skin type. A brand may be founded, designed, or manufactured in Taiwan; confirm formula, claims, and manufacturing details on its own listing.

faq.question: What products are in Beauty & Personal Care?
faq.answer: Skincare, body care, bath and shower, haircare, makeup, fragrance, and sun care can all appear, with narrower subcategories for primary use.

faq.question: Does Formoria endorse a beauty product?
faq.answer: No. The directory organises brand and product information and shows available declarations or verification; follow product labels and professional advice for use.

food-drink.title: Taiwanese food and beverage brands | Formoria
food-drink.description: Some stay in your own kitchen, others travel home as a gift. Taiwanese brands for tea, coffee, snacks, sauces, and sweets.
food-drink.intro: Ingredients, prepared foods, tea, coffee, snacks, and drinks; some stay in the kitchen, others travel home as a gift.
food-drink.definition: A food brand may be defined by its ingredients, source, recipe, processing method, or family practice. This category does not imply that every ingredient or product is Taiwan-made; listings show the brand's Taiwan connection and point to public information about origin and production.

faq.question: What can I find in Food & Beverage?
faq.answer: Tea, coffee, dried fruit, snacks, sauces, baked goods, and other everyday foods may appear, then sort into narrower subcategories by main product.

faq.question: Does a category label mean all ingredients are from Taiwan?
faq.answer: No. The category shows the range of brands and products; it is not an origin claim. Check each brand page for ingredient, source, and manufacturing information.

bags-accessories.title: Taiwanese bags and accessories brands | Formoria
bags-accessories.description: What fits inside and whether the strap digs in are usually the same question. Taiwanese brands for backpacks, wallets, eyewear, and hats.
bags-accessories.intro: Bags, leather goods, and everyday accessories; what fits inside and whether the strap digs in are usually the same question.
bags-accessories.definition: A brand may make bags, wallets, and other accessories at the same time, so subcategories follow the brand's main subcategories. Inclusion does not mean every item shares one material or manufacturing location; check the listing for the brand's own material and origin details.

faq.question: Which subcategories are included?
faq.answer: Backpacks, tote bags, crossbody bags, wallets, eyewear, hats, and travel accessories can appear when they match a brand's main product range.

faq.question: Do all leather-goods brands use real leather?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Brands may use leather, plant-based alternatives, recycled fabric, or other materials; each listing should be checked for the actual specification.

jewelry.title: Taiwanese jewelry brands | Formoria
jewelry.description: Metal content and care decide whether a piece can be worn every day. Taiwanese brands for earrings, necklaces, rings, and bracelets.
jewelry.intro: Earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, and hair accessories; metal composition and care decide whether a piece can be worn every day.
jewelry.definition: This category includes everyday accessories and jewelry design without assuming that every piece uses precious metal, natural stones, or Taiwan-sourced material. Brand pages separate material, making, and origin details where they can.

faq.question: How are jewelry and accessories organised here?
faq.answer: Primary product and how a piece is worn guide the subcategory, so everyday accessories and fine-jewelry labels can share an earrings, necklace, or ring page.

faq.question: Does Formoria verify the material of every piece?
faq.answer: No. Check the brand's material, stone, and production information; a category label is not a material guarantee.

kids.title: Taiwanese kids and baby brands | Formoria
kids.description: They end up in mouths and go through dozens of washes, so check material and washing first. Taiwanese brands for kids' clothing, bedding, toys, and tableware.
kids.intro: Children's and baby clothing, bedding, toys, tableware, and parenting essentials; they end up in mouths and go through dozens of washes, so material and washing are looked at first.
kids.definition: When choosing these products, check safety labeling, sizing, and age guidance first; the directory does not replace regulations, testing, or medical advice. A brand may be founded, designed, or manufactured in Taiwan; check its listing and packaging for age, material, and certification details.

faq.question: What products appear in Kids & Baby?
faq.answer: Children's and baby clothing, bedding, toys, learning aids, feeding goods, and parenting essentials may all appear in this category.

faq.question: Does Formoria confirm that a product suits every child?
faq.answer: No. The directory organises public brand information; age, size, safety, and care decisions should follow the product label and professional guidance.

stationery.title: Taiwanese stationery and design brands | Formoria
stationery.description: Paper weight and binding decide whether a notebook lies flat once opened. Taiwanese brands for pens, paper goods, washi tape, and desk tools.
stationery.intro: Notebooks, paper goods, pens, and desk tools; paper weight and binding decide whether a page lies flat once it is opened.
stationery.definition: A stationery product can differ through paper, ink, print, mechanism, or illustration rather than appearance alone. The Taiwan connection, manufacturing partners, and materials vary by brand, so the brand page remains the place to learn the specific details.

faq.question: What products are included in Stationery & Design?
faq.answer: Pens, notebooks, planners, paper goods, stamps, stickers, and desk organisers can appear, grouped by their primary use and subcategories.

faq.question: Are stationery products all made in Taiwan?
faq.answer: No. A brand may be founded, designed, or manufactured in Taiwan; each listing shows the available origin and production information separately.

outdoor.title: Taiwanese outdoor and camping brands | Formoria
outdoor.description: Low weight against damp resistance is the usual trade-off between Taiwan's mountains and coast. Taiwanese brands for hiking, camping, climbing, and travel gear.
outdoor.intro: Hiking, camping, climbing, and travel gear, plus the apparel, packs, and accessories that go with them; between Taiwan's mountains and its coast, low weight against damp resistance is the usual trade-off.
outdoor.definition: Terrain, weather, and user experience affect whether a piece of gear is appropriate; this category does not make safety or performance guarantees. Founding, design, and manufacturing connections are recorded separately, while specifications and load limits belong to each brand's product page.

faq.question: Which activities are covered by Outdoor & Camping?
faq.answer: Hiking, camping, climbing, and outdoor travel gear may appear, with subcategories that follow a product's primary use.

faq.question: Is every item here suitable for high-altitude trips?
faq.answer: No. Use the brand's specifications, testing conditions, and your own itinerary to choose equipment; a category path cannot make that decision for you.

bath-and-shower.title: Taiwanese bath and shower brands | Formoria
bath-and-shower.description: You use these up every day, so size and refill options are worth checking first. Taiwanese brands for body wash, facial cleansers, and everyday cleansing.
bath-and-shower.intro: Bathing, facial cleansing, and body wash products; they run out constantly, so size and refill options are worth checking first.
bath-and-shower.definition: This subcategory is about cleansing use, not a promise that a formula suits every skin type or has a particular origin. Check ingredients, directions, and the brand's available Taiwan connection and manufacturing details.

faq.question: How is Bath & Shower different from Body Care?
faq.answer: Bath and shower centres on removing sweat, oil, or dirt, while body care focuses on after-cleansing care; some brands span both uses.

faq.question: Can sensitive skin use every product here?
faq.answer: No. Read the ingredients and cautions for each product and seek professional advice when needed.

bath-and-shower.guidance: Check whether the formula is soap-based or amino-acid-based, and compare bottle sizes against refill options.

necklaces.title: Taiwanese necklace brands | Formoria
necklaces.description: Chain length decides whether a necklace sits at the collarbone or the chest. Necklace brands founded, designed, or made in Taiwan, by material and how they are worn.
necklaces.intro: Chains, pendants, and necklace designs of every kind; the length decides whether it sits at the collarbone or lower.
necklaces.definition: A necklace may use metal, stone, pearl, textile, or another material; this subcategory does not guarantee allergy, durability, or origin characteristics. Refer to the brand listing and product description for specifics.

faq.question: Can handmade labels appear in Necklaces?
faq.answer: Yes. A brand can appear when necklaces or pendants are among its primary products and it meets Formoria's directory scope.

faq.question: How do I confirm a necklace's material?
faq.answer: Read the brand's material, care, and origin information; the subcategory name does not imply a particular metal or stone.

necklaces.guidance: Chain length (choker, princess, opera) and clasp type affect everyday wearability.

earrings.title: Taiwanese earring brands | Formoria
earrings.description: Pierced ears or not, the choice works differently. Taiwanese brands for studs, clip-ons, and handmade earrings.
earrings.intro: Studs, clip-ons, and other pieces worn on the ear; pierced and unpierced call for entirely different choices.
earrings.definition: Weight, fastening, material, and fit affect how earrings feel; this subcategory does not replace product specifications or allergy information. The brand page explains its available founding, design, and manufacturing connection to Taiwan.

faq.question: Are clip-on earrings included?
faq.answer: Yes. Clip-ons and stud earrings are both ear-worn products, and brands are grouped according to their public subcategories.

faq.question: Are these earrings suitable for everyone?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Check the material, dimensions, and care information, especially if you have a metal sensitivity.

earrings.guidance: Distinguish studs from clip-ons, check whether the metal contains nickel, and consider single-earring weight for extended wear.

storage.title: Taiwanese storage brands | Formoria
storage.description: Measure the shelf depth first, then pick a style. Taiwanese brands for storage boxes, shelving, and organizers.
storage.intro: Boxes, racks, bags, and other storage pieces; measure the shelf depth first, then pick the style.
storage.definition: A storage product may also be furniture, travel gear, or a work accessory, so the subcategory follows the brand's main subcategories. Check dimensions, capacity, load, materials, and installation requirements before buying.

faq.answer: A brand whose main products are storage furniture or systems may also appear in Furniture; the route follows its subcategories.

faq.question: How should I choose storage for a small room?

storage.guidance: Measure available depth and height first, then compare load capacity, opening mechanism, and stackability.

furniture.description: Whether it fits through the elevator and the door frame is the first thing to check. Taiwanese brands for tables, chairs, cabinets, and bed frames.
furniture.intro: Tables, chairs, cabinets, bed frames, and other furniture; whether it fits through the lift and the door frame is the first line of the size chart.
furniture.definition: Furniture dimensions, structure, and materials need to suit the room and the way it is used; this subcategory does not imply that every piece is made by a Taiwan workshop. Check each brand's design, manufacturing, delivery, and installation information.

faq.question: What appears in Furniture?
faq.answer: Tables, chairs, cabinets, bed frames, and other objects that support everyday activities may appear in this subcategory.

faq.question: Can I buy furniture directly from Formoria?
faq.answer: Formoria is a brand directory. Visit each brand's own website or a stockist for pricing, dimensions, delivery, and purchase details.

furniture.guidance: Confirm the assembled dimensions (including packaging) clear your doorframe and lift, and note assembly method and material care needs.

skincare.title: Taiwanese skincare brands | Formoria
skincare.description: Each brand states its own ingredients and order of use. Taiwanese brands for cleansers, toners, serums, creams, and masks.
skincare.intro: Cleansers, toners, serums, moisturisers, and masks; ingredients and the order of use are stated by each brand.
skincare.definition: Skin needs vary with the person, season, and formula; this subcategory does not offer diagnosis or efficacy guarantees. Use the full ingredient list, directions, and available manufacturing or verification information when choosing.

faq.question: Does Skincare include makeup?
faq.answer: It focuses on care and cleansing; makeup appears in other Beauty & Personal Care subcategories, although a brand may cover several uses.

faq.question: Are product claims verified by Formoria?
faq.answer: No. Formoria organises brand information rather than endorsing product claims. Follow the label and professional guidance.

skincare.guidance: Compare active-ingredient concentrations, texture (watery, lotion, cream), and the brand's recommended application order.

tops-and-tshirts.title: Taiwanese tops and T-shirt brands | Formoria
tops-and-tshirts.description: The same size can mean a different shoulder line and length at every brand. Taiwanese brands for T-shirts, shirts, hoodies, and knitwear.

If you choose to receive marketing email, we also record the consent category, source, version, and time. We record browsing and usage events with PostHog and Google Analytics 4. Analytics events record the words you type into site search, so we can see what visitors are looking for and add the brands they cannot find; a search that looks like an email address or a phone number is not recorded at all. Analytics events exclude form values, names, email addresses, phone numbers, authentication codes, and tokens.

purpose.heading: Purpose of use
purpose.body: We collect personal data to build and maintain the Taiwan brand directory, provide discovery and search, improve brand information, prevent spam and abuse, improve the service, and send recommendation, claim, verification, security, and account-related notices. We send the newsletter only after separate consent, and you can turn it off at any time. Declining marketing email does not affect brand recommendations, account creation, or core service access.

thirdParty.heading: Third-party services
thirdParty.body: To provide our service, we use the following third-party providers: Supabase (database and authentication, servers in the US), Resend (email delivery, data may be processed in the US), PostHog and Google Analytics 4 (website analytics, data processed in the US), Sentry (error monitoring, data processed in the US), Cloudflare Turnstile (bot protection), and Railway (web hosting, servers in the US). We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Data is shared only to the extent necessary to provide our services.

userRights.heading: Your rights
userRights.body: Under Article 3 of the Personal Data Protection Act, you have the right to: query or request access to your personal data, request a copy, request corrections or supplements, request cessation of collection, processing, or use, and request deletion. To exercise any of these rights, please contact <privacy>privacy@formoria.com</privacy>. We will respond to your request within 30 days.

dataProtection.heading: Data protection
dataProtection.body: We protect personal data with HTTPS, access controls, and regular security reviews. Brand data is retained while the brand is listed, account data while the account remains active, and marketing-consent records until you withdraw consent or request deletion. After an unsubscribe request, we may retain a minimal suppression record so we do not send marketing email you have declined.

cookies.heading: Cookies and tracking
cookies.body: This website uses PostHog and Google Analytics 4 to record page views and usage events. PostHog is delivered through our e.formoria.com analytics endpoint, does not retain IP addresses, and has session replay disabled. Cloudflare Turnstile uses session cookies for bot detection to protect forms from spam. We do not use advertising cookies.

changes.heading: Policy changes
changes.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date. Your continued use of the service after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

faq.intro: Answers to the questions we hear most about listing rules, selection labels, and where to buy. Can't find yours? <contact>Contact us</contact>.

whatIsFormoria.question: What is Formoria?
whatIsFormoria.answer: Formoria is a curated platform for Taiwanese goods. It starts from a searchable directory of listed brands, bringing together brand information, product highlights, and each brand's own online stores and stockists. Anything Formoria selects is labeled separately.

listingVsSelection.question: What is the difference between a listed brand and a Formoria Selection?
listingVsSelection.answer: A listed brand meets the listing rules and can be found in the directory. Listing does not mean Formoria recommends, certifies, or ranks it. A Formoria Selection is a product our editors chose on purpose for a particular situation. It is labeled separately, and the reason for choosing it is written out.

purchaseThroughFormoria.question: Can I buy through Formoria?
purchaseThroughFormoria.answer: No. Formoria does not take orders or handle checkout. Price, variants, stock, shipping, and after-sales service are up to the brand or the store selling it. Our job is to help you find it, then hand you to the brand.

whoCanSubmit.question: Who can recommend a brand?
whoCanSubmit.answer: Anyone can recommend a brand. You do not need to be the brand owner.

taiwaneseBrandCriteria.question: Which brands qualify for listing?
taiwaneseBrandCriteria.answer: A brand qualifies if it was founded, designed, or made in Taiwan. Any one of the three is enough. For example, a company founded in Taipei qualifies under "founded"; a studio that designs in Taiwan and manufactures overseas qualifies under "designed"; a workshop making goods in Yingge qualifies under "made". Brand owners and fans alike can recommend one.

notListedBrands.question: What kinds of brands are not listed?
notListedBrands.answer: Formoria lists brands with their own products, so we do not list proxy buyers, curated or multi-brand shops without a product line of their own, platforms and retailers, media and review sites, importers of foreign brands, or personal accounts offering only services or digital goods. A curated shop that makes its own product line, or a creator with their own physical products, does qualify.

madeInTaiwanBadge.question: What does "Made in Taiwan" on a product mean?
madeInTaiwanBadge.answer: "Made in Taiwan" applies only to the product it appears on. We show it when the product matches a current record in the MIT Smile registry run by Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs, or when checks confirm it is made in Taiwan and its main materials come from Taiwan. Listing review only confirms that a brand exists and meets the listing rules; it does not judge where products are made.

howToSubmit.question: How do I recommend a brand to Formoria?
howToSubmit.answer: Anyone can recommend a brand. Open the recommendation form, enter the brand name and an official link, and send it; Formoria will review it. Recommending is free. The review checks that the information is complete, the brand exists, and it has a real connection to Taiwan.

reviewTime.question: How long does review take?
reviewTime.answer: Review usually takes about 7 business days. We check that the brand exists, the information is complete, and it meets the listing rules. Once approved, the brand appears in the directory. If information is missing, we may email the person who recommended it.

dataAccuracy.question: What if brand information is wrong?
dataAccuracy.answer: Brand information comes from recommendations and public sources, and we check it before it goes live. If something is wrong or out of date, use "Report incorrect information" on the brand page, or contact us from the footer.

isBrandFree.question: Does it cost anything to be listed?
isBrandFree.answer: No. Recommending and listing are both free, and paying never changes listing or ranking.

intention.scene: Moving into a new home, wanting one corner of the living room to feel different, and ending up in IKEA again.
intention.detail: A search turns up mostly marketplaces and price-comparison pages. Few places lay out Taiwanese things by room, occasion, or budget.

encounter.scene: Stopping at a stall at a design fair and holding a desk lamp for a long time.
encounter.detail: Back home, the phone holds one blurry photo of the stall, and the brand's name is unreadable.

alternatives.scene: Picking out a cup you like, to give as a gift.
alternatives.detail: Before ordering, a dozen tabs open on similar cups. Each brand's site describes only itself, so nothing sits side by side.

adjacent.scene: Carrying the same brand's canvas bag for years, and starting to notice how it chooses materials and makes things.
adjacent.detail: Plenty of Taiwanese brands work with the same care, but each runs on its own, and they rarely appear in one place.

loop.heading: Connecting the path
loop.body1: Formoria is a curated platform for Taiwanese goods. We don't sell anything, and we aren't a magazine: we gather and sort what is known about Taiwanese brands so you can look by what you need, and the few products we pick ourselves are marked Formoria Selection.
loop.body2: From one thing you love, you can reach the brand that makes it, read how it came to be, and go to the place that sells it. That path used to break. We connect it.
loop.pullQuote: Formoria never handles the sale. We connect what you love to the place you can buy it, then hand you over to the brand.
loop.brandBody: Taiwan's good work is scattered across brands' own sites, markets, and social accounts. Formoria gathers these brands into one directory, so people looking can find them by category and go on to the brand's own site or a stockist. We take no commission and sell nothing ourselves.
